correctness.rationale: For n=4 and n=5, exact upper-triangular occupancy matrix M_{k,j}=S(n,k)(j)_{k}/j^n is invertible. Inclusion-exclusion yields every homogeneous coefficient in ordered gaps of q_k. The checker enumerates all 35 and 126 degree-n monomials, respectively, and proves every rational coefficient of w=M^{-1}q nonnegative. Since all ordered gaps are nonnegative for all real categorical laws, this is a proof across the continuum, not finite sampling. Independent exact labeled-path enumeration tests the identities. Column stochasticity gives sum_j w_j=1 and invertibility uniqueness. Scope restricted to alphabet <=n.

value.rationale: Determines the entire convex feasible set of four- and five-draw richness laws within the natural regime that the category support is at most the number of draws, the first two unresolved sample sizes in Zhu's exchangeable richness question. This simultaneously controls all distinct-count coordinates via unique, nonnegative weights; structural polynomial positivity is stronger than a numerical extremum or a routine special-case scalar bound. It does not assert the unrestricted conjecture.
